'''Vaathkree''', also known as '''Vaath'kror''', was a [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector's]] [[Periphery/Legends|Periphery]] region. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Vaathkree (species)|Vaathkree]] [[Species/Legends|species]], members of which had skin covered in a layer of [[Stone/Legends|stone]] or [[Metal/Legends|metal]] and were avid, religious [[Merchant/Legends|traders]]. The Vaathkree constructed [[vnal]]s, sentient, partly organic [[Domed city/Legends|domed cities]], for housing off-world visitors to their homeworld.

Although Vaathkree was historically situated in territory influenced by members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] species, by [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Annexation of the northern Hutt territories|annexed]] Vaathkree and its surrounding [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] area, although the Empire mostly ignored the planet. During their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of the Vaath'kror system|conquered]] the [[Vaath'kror system]].

==Description==
Vaathkree,<ref name="Thrawn" /> also named Vaath'kror after the [[Vaath'kror system|star system]] it was situated in,<ref name="Sisar" /> was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Thrawn" /> located in the [[Periphery/Legends|Periphery]], a part of the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The planet was connected by [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Solacton system/Legends|Solacton]] and [[Sriluur system/Legends|Sriluur systems]], lying at a distance of one [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] and two hours' [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel using a Class 1 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], respectively. Occupying the third and outermost [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position in the Vaath'kror [[Star system/Legends|system]], Vaathkree was a considerable distance away from the other two planets of the system,<ref name="Sisar" /> with its [[Local year|year]] lasting 197 [[Local day/Legends|local days]], each of which was fifty-four standard hours long.<ref name="Thrawn" />

The planet had heavy, 1.8 standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] and a corrosive, [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]], searing [[Temperature/Legends|hot]] Type IV [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] that necessitated the use of [[Environment suit/Legends|environment suits]] for most [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings. Vaathkree's harsh, highly volatile surface, which suffered constant [[Meteorite/Legends|meteor]] impacts, included chains of active [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] and deep crevasses as well as extensive flats of [[Magma/Legends|lava]] and exposed [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] [[Metal/Legends|metals]]. The planet had an [[Water/Legends|arid]] [[Hydrosphere/Legends|hydrosphere]].<ref name="Thrawn" />

==History==
[[Realspace/Legends|Space]] surrounding Vaathkree was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]] and [[8000 BBY]], although<ref name="TEA" /> the planet<ref name="Thrawn" /> had already been located in the territory controlled by members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] by [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the [[Pius Dea Era]], a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] between approximately [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]] and [[11,000 BBY]], Vaathkree was situated outside the borders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was a part of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], when the Republic's [[Thirteenth Army|Thirteenth Sector Army]] was charged with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in Vaathkree's vicinity as part of the first campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] that [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|began]] that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].<ref name="EGTW" />

By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], the northern portions of Hutt Space, including Vaathkree, were [[Annexation of the northern Hutt territories|annexed]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="EGTW" /> although that government mostly ignored the planet.<ref name="Thrawn" /> The Vaath'kror system was [[Battle of the Vaath'kror system|attacked]] at some point between [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] and [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]] by the military forces of the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] species as part of its [[Yuuzhan Vong War|conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and the [[Star/Legends|star]] system remained under the invaders' [[Yuuzhan Vong empire|control]] by 27 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Main|Vaathkree (species)}}
[[File:Valka.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Vaathkree was home to a sentient species of the same name.]]
Vaathkree was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Vaathkree (species)|Vaathkree]], sentient [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] whose skin was covered in small scales or plates of [[Stone/Legends|stone]] or metal. The Vaathkree began their multi-stage life cycle as "Stonesingers"&mdash;small, mobile nodes of living metal [[Ore/Legends|ore]] that inhabited the planet Vaathkree's lava flats and crevasses. Young Stonesingers did not possess cognitive abilities and spent the nights roaming their homeworld's plains and absorbing bits of lava and stone, which were then incorporated into the fluid structure of their bodies. Over a period of two [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]], the Stonesingers evolved into mature Vaathkree, in the process adopting a permanent&mdash;most frequently [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]]&mdash;shape.<ref name="Thrawn" />

For many [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]], the Vaathkree, who communicated in the [[Vaathkree trade language]], were active members of the Republic, and they were active [[Merchant/Legends|traders]], adhering to a religious tradition known as [[The Deal]]. The population of Vaathkree numbered six billion, and it was governed by the [[Vaathkree Council]]. The Vaathkree society had reached the space [[Technology level|level of technology]], and it imported [[Computer/Legends|computers]], [[Droid/Legends|droids]], and other high technology from off-world while exporting mid-level technology and raw materials.<ref name="Thrawn" />

Off-world tourists often encountered the Vaathkree Stonesingers on the planet but were ordered to only observe them from afar. The natives of Vaathkree created the [[vnal]] [[City/Legends|cities]] to house any visitors from elsewhere in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], although despite the vnals being comfortable for short-term visits, over extended periods of stay the guests of the planet mostly found the living nature of the cities to be disturbing.<ref name="Thrawn" />

==Locations==
Vaathkree had an [[Imperial-class spaceport]]. The planet's surface was also dotted by vnals&mdash;partly organic [[Domed city/Legends|domed cities]] that were living, breathing, and sentient constructs created by the Vaathkree through the use of unusual [[Metallurgy/Legends|metallurgy]] and [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]] techniques.<ref name="Thrawn" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Vaathkree was first mentioned in the [[1994]] ''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]'', written by [[Eric S. Trautmann|Eric Trautmann]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]''</ref> The [[1997]] sourcebook ''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]'' further introduced the alternate name "Vaath'kror" for the planet,<ref name="Sisar" /> and the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Vaath'kror system, and therefore the planet itself, in grid square S-8.<ref name="TEA" />
